method: Use the existing bodyBox and rasterPlacement on the exact published wave31 frames. Analytic actor coordinates are a geometry calculation, not a captured match or executed attack.
cause: spawnProjectile uses the generic body envelope at y + 0.45*h. The frame-specific gun muzzle is higher and farther forward. Camera placement scales both together and is not the cause.

samples.pointStatus: Manually reviewed point on the published candidate PNG; subsequently implemented for wave32, not original-game geometry.

proposal.scope: Only exact owner, source, neutralSpecial, active pose frame, dimensions and SHA matching the reviewed record. No copied profiles, other Walter form, super, desperation, traps or ground effects.
proposal.calculation: worldX = actor.x + placement.flip * (placement.localX + muzzleX * placement.scale); worldY = actor.y + placement.localY + muzzleY * placement.scale
proposal.integration: Use the same derived x/y for the physical projectile object and its renderer. Preserve the existing generic origin for all unmatched cases.
proposal.gameplayImpact: This intentionally changes the initial projectile collision position for the two exact attacks. It is not a cosmetic-only fix; projectile speed, radius, lifetime, damage, spread and source move behavior must stay explicit and tested.
proposal.renderingOnlyOffsetRejected: Offsetting only draw coordinates would leave hits below the visible shot and conceal the defect.
